def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # normalize species labels (case variants)
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.capitalize()
    df.loc[~df['species'].isin(['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo']), 'species'] = pd.NA
    # fix island typos
    island_map = {'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'}
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace(island_map)
    # flipper_length_mm stored as text with negative signs -> numeric, take abs
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce').abs()
    # body_mass_g stored as text -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    totals = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in totals.items()}
